CloudContactBackup.title: CloudContactBackup
CloudContactBackup.description: Backed up contact entry stored privately under a signed-in user's subcollection.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this backup entry.

label.description: Contact label such as Mobile, Work, Home, or Priority Contact.

priorityContact.description: Whether the contact is marked as a priority caller in Lyra.

ownerContact.description: Whether this contact represents the device owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when first backed up.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when updated.

/users/{userId}/cloud_contacts/{contactI.description: User-owned cloud backup of contacts and priority caller flags.
